For a model built over only a subset of `n.snapshots`, `solve_model` passes `_to_model(n, n.snapshots)` to `extra_functionality`, rather than the model’s stored snapshots. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, no flattening occurs, so the callback receives the full network snapshot index, including snapshots outside the model.
